apps.filter.label: Show apps in these categories
apps.safe-bridge.name: Safe Connect
apps.safe-bridge.summary: Use an existing Safe on another chain as the source of funds. Assets never move. Deliberation and policy run here, the Safe keeps enforcing its own threshold.
apps.moneygram-payout.name: MoneyGram Payout
apps.moneygram-payout.summary: Cash collection in 100+ countries. Employees convert salary without a bank account. Only the aggregate and the recipient reference leave the account.
apps.wise-payout.name: Wise Transfers
apps.wise-payout.summary: Multi currency payout to local bank accounts at interbank rates. Handles the leg between settlement and an employee bank account.
apps.monument-gbp.name: Monument Deposits
apps.monument-gbp.summary: Fund payroll from a UK bank account in tokenised sterling. No stablecoin conversion and no offramp needed, because the asset is already a regulated deposit.
apps.treasury-yield.name: Treasury Yield
apps.treasury-yield.summary: Deploy idle treasury into lending markets without publishing the strategy. Proposes moves inside an allowance you set. It cannot move funds on its own.
apps.xero-sync.name: Xero Sync
apps.xero-sync.summary: Posts settled payroll to your ledger as a single journal entry. Reads totals only, so your accounting integration never holds individual salaries.
apps.quickbooks-sync.name: QuickBooks Sync
apps.quickbooks-sync.summary: Posts settled payroll to your ledger as a single journal entry. Reads totals only, so your accounting integration never holds individual salaries.
apps.hmrc-rti.name: HMRC Real Time Information
apps.hmrc-rti.summary: Files UK payroll submissions from an attestation rather than a spreadsheet of salaries. Issues the proof, submits the return.
apps.auditor-portal.name: Auditor Portal
apps.auditor-portal.summary: Scoped, time boxed access for an external accountant. They verify what they need and see nothing else, and the grant expires on its own.
apps.vesting.name: Vesting and Cap Table
apps.vesting.summary: Scheduled disbursement with shielded amounts on the same engine as payroll. Cliffs are provable without being publicly trackable.
apps.contributor-bounties.name: Contributor Payouts
apps.contributor-bounties.summary: Pay contributors and bounty claimants from the same account, confidentially, without adding them to the payroll roster.
